findings.explanation: The new GET /admin/export endpoint is protected with @require_role("admin") (app/routes/admin.py, added lines), which is exactly the check mandated by security-policy.md §4 ('Every endpoint under /admin requires the admin role, enforced with @require_role("admin")') and api-spec.md ('/admin/export | GET | admin only'). The require_role decorator (app/auth.py:69-85) correctly authenticates via bearer token and enforces ROLE_RANK >= admin, returning 401/403 otherwise. The endpoint returns bulk user/order data, which is appropriate for an admin-only reporting export. No missing or incorrect authorization check is present.

evidence.content:
def require_role(minimum_role: str):
    ... if ROLE_RANK.get(user.role, 0) < ROLE_RANK.get(minimum_role, 99): return jsonify({"error": "insufficient role"}), 403
Every endpoint under /admin requires the admin role, enforced with @require_role("admin"). There are NO alternative access paths to admin functionality.
